Top Rx Health Checkup & Performance Dashboard

India Rise (India_Next) · Jul 1 – Aug 25, 2026 · Toing Excluded · Baseline: June 2026
Fresh deals (<5 runs in 30 days) deliver 37× more IOPD than stale deals (20+)

What is Top Rx?

A campaign where sales reps negotiate steep item-level discounts to drive traffic and IOPD. Universe = TOP_RX_RAW (Date × Restaurant × Item). Scope = India_Next only. Toing excluded. Baseline = June 2026.

Quality Buckets

Restaurant Quality: city-ranked GMV using CUME_DIST over previous month. Item Quality: within-restaurant cumulative item GMV share. Both: Top 20% / Top 50% / Top 70% / Above 70% / Unranked. In the matrix these show as % contribution not absolute counts.

Discount & Price Buckets

Depth = (Listing − Deal) / Listing. Buckets: ≤40% | 40-50% | 50-60% | >60%. Price Point on Item_Input_Price: ₹1 | ₹2-9 | ₹10-19 | ₹20-49 | ₹50-99 | ₹100+. Avail% and Depth% are already in 0-100 scale.

IOPD Metrics

IOPD Commit = SUM of MAX(Expected_IOPD) per restaurant per day. IOPD Achieved = SUM of (Campaign Orders − Baseline Avg Daily Orders). Achievement% = Achieved / Commit.

Deal Fatigue

Rolling 30-day count of same item at deal price within ±5%. Buckets: <5 | 5-10 | 10-15 | 15-20 | 20+. Fresh deals deliver 37× more IOPD than stale.

Availability

Restaurant Avail% = L7 actual/ideal open duration. Item Avail% = L7 available/(available+hs). % Depth Issue = items with L7 avail < 90%.

Top/Bottom 50 Logic

perf_score = z-scores within cluster: 0.25·IOPD + 0.20·IncGMV + 0.20·M2OLift + 0.15·Achievement + 0.20·IncItemGMV. Top 50: all gates pass (enabled, image, quality, fresh, depth 40-60%, avail≥90%, IOPD>0). Bottom 50: any gate triggers.

M2O %

M2O Camp% = Order Sessions / Menu Sessions on campaign day. M2O Lift = Camp% − Base% (in percentage points). Positive = campaign improved conversion.
